node.title: Re^3: locating ultima thule
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Path::Tiny paths require defined, positive-length parts

[https://metacpan.org/source/DAGOLDEN/Path-Tiny-0.108/lib/Path/Tiny.pm#L223|AFAICT that means] that one of the paths involved in the operation was either undef or had zero [doc://length]. It'd be best if you [doc://Data::Dumper|dump] the elements of the paths involved, in this case I guess that'd be $vars{to_images} and $AoA[$i][0], and if you're unsure as to what's causing the problem, show the output here.
